annotations.title: Get a datasheet's PCB layout rules

description: Get the PCB layout rules DatasheetVend already extracted from a datasheet (the layout, decoupling, keep-out and thermal-pad rules of its pin-cautions rulebook), grouped by topic: decoupling, placement, grounding, routing, keep_out, thermal, rf, emi. Each rule carries the manufacturer's sentence and page, the pins it names, any length the datasheet printed (in mm), and layout_check: which rule of datasheetvend_check_pcb_layout can measure it on your routed board, the limit when the datasheet printed one, and what you must supply yourself. It extracts nothing new: it is a view of a stored extraction, so a sentence that extraction missed is not here, and an empty answer says so and is NOT proof the datasheet has no layout guidance. It does NOT read layout figures. Most datasheets print no distance ('as close as possible'); then the number is your choice, and the answer says so. Pass the job_id of an extraction in your account that ran the pin_cautions module. Deterministic: runs DatasheetVend's checks in code, calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key.

job_id.description: An extraction in your account that ran the pin_cautions module.
